svg.text: yarilo — standalone Helm release · single-node k8s · independent Deployments per component
no director · each component has its own replicaCount · all coordination via ClusterIP Services + mTLS
Helm release: yarilo-standalone (one chart, many Deployments)
mTLS TCP · auth preamble · plain-byte proxy (ClusterIP Service DNS — separate pods, no fd-pass)
control plane · mTLS over ClusterIP Service DNS
sessions → yarilo-locks (X locks · EVENT) · sessions → yarilo-auth (userdb) · logins → yarilo-anvil (rate-limit) · logins → yarilo-auth (passdb)
PersistentVolumeClaim · ReadWriteMany (NFS · CephFS · hostPath on single node)
shared by every session pod · cross-pod write coordination via yarilo-locks
• Every box is its own k8s Deployment (or StatefulSet for redis). Bump replicaCount per component — no rewiring.
• login pods and session pods are SEPARATE Deployments. Connect via mTLS TCP + auth preamble through ClusterIP Service DNS — not Unix-socket fd-pass.
• yarilo-locks scales independently (default 2 for HA). State in Redis means N session pods see one consistent view.
• PVC must be ReadWriteMany — even on a single node, multiple session pods mount the same volume. hostPath / NFS / CephFS all valid; storageClass in values.yaml.
• Redis is bundled by default (StatefulSet subchart). For HA point at external managed Redis (Sentinel / Cluster) by overriding the connection URL.
• No director, no per-tag sharding. Cross-pod write contention handled by yarilo-locks. Upgrade path to backend deployment (with director) does not touch session binaries.
• SASL AUTH: smtpd_sasl_type=dovecot · smtpd_sasl_path=inet:[yarilo-auth.svc]:12345 — Postfix authenticates SMTP submission users via yarilo-auth.
• Quota policy: check_policy_service inet:[yarilo-quota-status.svc]:12340 — rejects delivery to over-quota recipients before Postfix queues the message.
• Virtual alias resolution: configure alias_dict in quota_status.yaml pointing at the same SQL DB — yarilo-quota-status resolves aliases before quota check.

• LMTP: mailbox_transport = lmtp:inet:[yarilo-lmtp-login.svc]:24 — Postfix delivers to yarilo-lmtp-login; per-recipient anvil tracking + SESSION tokens; fan-out preamble to yarilo-lmtp. Enable: components.lmtpLogin.enabled: true in values.yaml.
